::: {#rem-entropy-chain-rule-from-surprisal}
#### The chain rule for entropy is the chain rule for surprisal on average

The [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) of a pair
is the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation)
of its [joint surprisal](#def-joint-surprisal),
and the [conditional entropy](#def-conditional-entropy)
is the expectation of the [conditional surprisal](#def-conditional-surprisal):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{X, Y} &= \E{\surprisalf{X, Y}} \\
\entropyf{Y \mid X} &= \E{\surprisalf{Y \mid X}}.
\end{aligned}
$$

Taking the expectation of both sides of @thm-surprisal-chain-rule
therefore gives @thm-entropy-chain-rule.

:::
